name: usb
label: Upper sideband (voice)
description: Upper-sideband SSB receiver for amateur voice/digital — 20 m / 17 m / 15 m DX, 10 m FM-mode simplex, 6 m calling. Source 2.4 MS/s IQ. Channelizer decimates by 50 to a 48 kS/s baseband (cutoff ~3 kHz after windowing, matching a classic 2.8–3 kHz communications passband). SsbDemod runs at 48 kS/s with Hilbert-phasing to recover USB and reject the lower sideband by ≳ 24 dB. Output goes straight to the AudioSink; no post-demod decimator needed because the channelizer already lands us on 48 kS/s. Server-side FFT/LogMagU8 spectrum chain matches the other receivers so the visualisation is identical.
